title: Zucchini, Bacon & Cheese Slice
description: Thermomix for the prep, oven for the bake. Bacon crisped separately so it stays crunchy rather than going soggy.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a slice tin (approx. 20 × 30cm).
In a pan, cook the bacon ({{bacon}}) over medium heat until crisp. Set aside.
Grate the zucchini ({{zucchini}}) 5 sec / Speed 5. Tip into the nut milk bag and squeeze out as much liquid as possible. This step decides whether the slice sets.
Add the onion ({{onion}}) to the bowl. Chop 3 sec / Speed 5. Scrape down.

Add the squeezed zucchini, crisped bacon, eggs ({{eggs}}), flour ({{flour}}), cheese ({{cheese}}), oil ({{oil}}), salt ({{salt}}) and pepper ({{pepper}}). Mix 15 sec / Reverse / Speed 3 until just combined.
Pour into the lined tin and bake about 35 minutes, until golden and set in the centre.
Cool in the tin 10 minutes before slicing.

notes.title: Golden on top but liquid in the middle
notes.text: Cover with foil, drop the oven to 150°C, and keep going in 10–15 minute increments, checking with a skewer.

notes.title: Air fryer
notes.text: A slice tin that fits takes about 25–30 minutes at 160–170°C. Watch the edges so they do not dry out.

notes.title: Storage
notes.text: 5 days in the fridge, 3 months in the freezer. Wrap individual portions before putting them in an airtight container.

notes.title: Veg swaps
notes.text: Yellow squash, carrot and pumpkin all work in place of the zucchini.
